semanticSides.body.leg.left: character anatomical left; near side for up-left rear three-quarter view, traced from left hip through its femur/knee/ankle, independent of screen position and crossing
semanticSides.body.leg.right: character anatomical right; far side for up-left rear three-quarter view, traced from right hip through its femur/knee/ankle, independent of screen position and crossing
semanticSides.body.arm.left: character anatomical left arm, near side
semanticSides.body.arm.right: character anatomical right arm, far side
semanticSides.body.hand.left: character anatomical left hand; near side in up-left rear three-quarter view, may cross the lower back toward screen-right
semanticSides.body.hand.right: character anatomical right hand; far side in up-left rear three-quarter view, usually visible on screen-left
semanticSides.body.torso: rear-facing undershirt and safety-shorts torso mass; polygon is subordinate to explicit arm/hand/leg ownership
semanticSides.head.base: same bald rear-three-quarter head for all poses; headPartition identifies visible head pixels only, with no facial features
